environment.description: AWS Lambda (Quarkus native image) behind API Gateway with Cognito authorizer. Lambda execution role uses a scoped IAM policy with dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition. The policy includes a StringLike condition on dynamodb:LeadingKeys that references ${cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:sub} via the role's trust policy federation mapping. However, note that the condition uses 'ForAllValues:StringEquals' on 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' which only constrains operations that reference partition keys — the actual enforcement depends on whether the SDK call includes the key in the request context. The role's session tags are propagated from the Cognito identity pool's attribute mapping (sub → principalTag:userSub). The condition key dynamodb:LeadingKeys is evaluated against items where pk begins with 'USER#${aws:PrincipalTag/userSub}'.

config.trust_policy_note: Role trust policy allows cognito-identity.amazonaws.com with sts:TagSession for principal tag propagation
config.table_schema: pk (String), sk (String) - composite key, pk format: USER#<uuid>
